coverage: Research checked 19 October 2026. Latest Albion men’s result verified: 17 October 2026, home 3–2 against Blackburn.
2025/26 national cups complete: League Cup first-round exit against Derby; FA Cup third round against Swansea, fourth-round exit against Norwich.
The 2019 play-off second-leg 1–0 win after extra time counts as an Albion match win. The penalty shootout decides the tie and does not replace the goals.

Swansea FA Cup, 11 January 2026: the 5–6 shootout is confirmed by the official fixture https://www.wba.co.uk/fixture/view/79526 and Albion’s report. Seven Albion attempts, six scored. One Reddit post incorrectly says 7–8.

Charity Shield dates cross-checked in Wildstat; scores in James Ross/RSSSF, whose page explicitly permits copying with proper acknowledgement. The 1920 competition designation was Albion–Spurs, but the venue was White Hart Lane; this file records Tottenham as the home team.

All 22 major European fixtures entered: four 1966/67 Fairs Cup, six 1968/69 Cup Winners' Cup, eight 1978/79 UEFA Cup, two 1979/80 UEFA Cup, two 1981/82 UEFA Cup. Minor cross-border competitions (Texaco, Anglo-Italian, Anglo-Scottish, Tennent Caledonian) are not included in these 22.

European cross-check pitfalls: Wikipedia's European article sometimes lists home goals first for away fixtures; it misleadingly displays Galatasaray away 1–3 which means Albion won3–1. DFB's Red Star firstleg has wrong1March1979date: footballsite and contemporary competition record7March1979correct. Grasshoppers Wikipedia has1–1 firstleg typo; UEFA officialtitleandfootballsite1–0correct.

Walsall rivalry narrative should describe neighbouring clubs and infrequent competitive meetings. The 2005 official programme recalls Walsall’s 4–1 win in 2003/04; use archive results for the exact 9 August 2003 date. Do not invent equal intensity with Wolves or Villa.
53 completed first-team cup matches included; one further result awaits reconciliation of its date. Watney Cup is a named pre-season invitation tournament, distinguished from ordinary friendlies.

RSSSF Anglo-Italian documents explicitly permit reuse with attribution: credit Andrea Veronese (1970 and 1971) and Erik Garin (1993–94 and 1995–96), Rec.Sport.Soccer Statistics Foundation. FCHD asks that F.C.H.D. be credited.

Texaco Cup: all nine Albion games across 1970–71, 1972–73 and 1974–75. Anglo-Scottish: five included group games and one deferred game across 1975–76 and 1976–77. RSSSF results checked against separate dated season records.

Anglo-Italian Cup: 20 completed games across 1969–70, 1970–71, 1993–94 and 1995–96. The abandoned match at Lanerossi Vicenza on 16 May 1970 is excluded: 1–1 when stopped, RSSSF reports a 0–2 loss awarded to both teams. It cannot be represented as a conventional final score.

Full Members' Cup: nine matches across 1985–86 through 1990–91. Includes sponsor names Simod and Zenith Data Systems as the same competition. FCHD's 1990–91 opponent 'Burnley' is a transcription error; use Barnsley.
Associate Members'/Football League Trophy: seven first-team games in 1991–92 and 1992–93. Modern academy/U21 EFL Trophy entries are not first-team matches and are excluded.

Watney Cup: three 1971 matches. The official club museum article gives final date 6 August, but opponent Colchester's archive, multiple season records, and programme evidence give Saturday 7 August 1971. Use 7 August.
1976–77 Nottingham Forest match withheld: two dated archives say 11 August, but 10 August is also reported. Retained under pendingMatches for further research.

Remaining gaps beyond this file: regional senior cups, charity invitation cups such as Bass Charity Vase, friendlies/tours/testimonials, early football and wartime football. No exhaustive claim for those.
